verdict.rationale: Docs claim resume from standby under 25ms even after weeks of inactivity, implying sub-second warm start, and scale-to-zero after 5s inactivity, which is documented performance behavior specific to sandboxes. However, this is vendor-claimed only with no independent benchmark or hands-on cold-start timing (first-boot from image) reported, and no numbers for true 'cold start' (first creation) vs resume-from-standby. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks/hands-on cold-start measurements, explicit distinction between first-time cold start and standby resume times.
